title: RequiredDataSource
description: A first-class data requirement declared by a persona. Describes which dataset the persona needs, how it must be sourced, which connectors can satisfy the requirement, and what policy gates must be cleared before binding.

dataset.description: Stable dataset identifier, e.g. tw_price_daily, tw_options_hourly, finmind_broker_flow.

market.description: Market scope for this data requirement, e.g. TW, US, HK.

cadence.description: Required delivery cadence for this dataset.

source_class.description: Classification of the data source binding type. 'live_push' and 'live_pull' require an approved, active connector. 'seed_only' declares a seed label — this class MUST NOT be used as live data source binding proof.

connector_candidates.description: Ordered list of connector IDs that can satisfy this data requirement. The source provisioning reconciler evaluates these in order.

policy_gates.description: Policy gate identifiers that must pass before binding is considered active, e.g. require_connector_approved, require_schedule_active, require_freshness_within_1d.
